title: The Hidden Root quest ('the gap in the black thorn is at the wood's north-west corner') sent me through ~25 turns of a deep-wood maze of near-identically-described rooms (Deer Break, Split Beech, Spoil Verge, Bramble Break, The Bluff...) trying every unexplored exit from every reachable node, and the black-thorn gap was never found — the compass bearing never matched the room graph's actual layout.
